title: dynaprune budget/policy
description: What the user wants: a byte budget or explicit prune fraction, a precision tier, ranking and compensation choices, structural clamps, and which controls to generate alongside. Fully resolved by the planner into a frozen plan.

target.description: Exactly one of budget_bytes or prune_fraction. budget_bytes is resolved to the smallest block-quantized prune that fits.

budget_bytes.description: Ceiling on total resident artifact bytes (weights only). KV and runtime overheads are accounted separately in admission.

reserve_bytes.description: Bytes held back from budget_bytes for KV/graphs when the budget expresses a device ceiling.

function.description: Built-ins: routed_mass, error_proxy, write_gain. Plus controls: random, frequency. Anything else must resolve to a registered plugin.

params.description: Ranker-specific parameters (e.g. weights for combined signals).

seed.description: Required for random control; recorded for any stochastic ranker.

layer_rate.description: How the per-layer prune rate is set (layer-adaptive rates are the point of non-uniform pruning).

explicit_keep.description: layer → keep count; used when mode = explicit.

compensation.description: Optional STEP-style bias compensation applied at derivation. Requires a mean_output signal in the observation set.

block.description: Units are removed in whole blocks of this size per layer (kernel alignment).

layer_floor.description: Minimum retained units in any prunable layer; must be a multiple of block.

protected_layers.description: Layers never pruned (dense layers, MTP heads, ...).

protected_units.description: layer:index pairs never pruned (e.g. shared experts).

controls.description: Control arms the planner must emit next to the main plan so no comparison is run without them (METHOD §3).

serving.description: Adapter hints carried into the manifest; not part of selection.
